content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Article X(b) (¶p0125) imposes a one-way non-solicit on Licensee covering *all* Licensor and Affiliate employees for three years after expiration or termination — a material failure of the fallback (mutual, involved personnel only, 12 months) and past the 24-month walk-away line. The clause's own "Solicit" definition already excludes general job advertising and responsive/voluntary inquiries, and it contains no no-hire, so I left that sentence verbatim and made a single surgical replacement of the operative sentence to make the covenant mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services under the Agreement, and 12 months from the end of that involvement.
